records.title: Fundamental Limitations on Subquadratic Alternatives to Transformers
records.reason: The paper studies theoretical lower bounds and complexity limits for subquadratic alternatives to attention; it does not present an LLM inference or serving optimization to evaluate.

records.title: Solving Token Gradient Conflict in Mixture-of-Experts for Large Vision-Language Model
records.reason: The contribution resolves training-time token-gradient conflicts for LVLM mixture-of-experts. The abstract discusses MoE inference savings as motivation, but the proposed method optimizes training and does not establish an inference-efficiency gain.

records.title: TokenPool-Scheduler: Token-Level GPU Pooling and Resource Slicing for Multi-Model Co-Location
records.reason: No primary full-text sections were accessible in this review; do not infer performance or quality results from the abstract.

records.title: Structure-Aware Unified Modeling for Root Cause Localization in Microservice Systems Using Multi-Source Observability Data
records.reason: The method localizes root causes in microservice systems from observability data; it is not an LLM inference/serving method.

records.title: Dr. Kernel: Reinforcement Learning Done Right for Triton Kernel Generations
records.reason: The paper trains LLMs to generate Triton kernels and studies RL for kernel-code quality/reward hacking. Its target is code-generation training, not optimization of LLM inference or serving.
